title: Machines & Metals
description: A modpack focused on industrialisation, automation and metallurgy. Featuring Create, Applied Energetics 2 and much more...
body:
**Machines & Metals** is a modern automation modpack built around e**ngineering, industry, and large-scale mechanical production.** If you enjoy designing factories, optimizing logistics, and watching complex systems work on their own, this pack provides the tools to make it happen.

At the heart of the pack are **Applied Energistics 2** for advanced storage networks and **Create** with a wide collection of addons for mechanical automation. Players can construct conveyor-based factories, kinetic machinery, and intelligent crafting systems that transform raw resources into fully processed materials.

**Key Features**

- Advanced item and resource logistics using storage networks
- Rotational machinery, gears, and contraption-based automation
- Extensive Create mod addon support
- Multi-stage production lines and factory engineering
- Large-scale industrial expansion possibilities
- Technical progression that rewards planning and optimization

**Gameplay Philosophy**

The pack focuses on creative engineering rather than simple crafting. Build living mechanical systems where mining, processing, storage, and manufacturing can all operate automatically. From compact smart machines to vast industrial complexes, every design choice matters.

**Why Play Machines & Metals?**

If you want to turn Minecraft into a world of motion, logic, and industry where machines do the work for you, Machines & Metals lets you build the automated future inside your game.
